Perfect! All 46 tests pass. I've implemented the invoice numbering system:

**`src/numbering.js`** — `nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate)`:
- Extracts the year from issueDate (YYYY-MM-DD format)
- Filters existing numbers for that year
- Finds the max counter and increments it (starting at 0001 for new years)
- Returns `ok('INV-2026-0042')` with zero-padded 4-digit counter
- Returns `fail('DATE_INVALID')` if date format is invalid

**`src/invoices.js`** — `issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers)`:
- Requires invoice.status to be 'draft' (else returns NOT_DRAFT)
- Calls `nextInvoiceNumber` to get the next number
- Returns `ok(newInvoice)` with number set and status changed to 'issued'
- Preserves all other invoice properties and doesn't mutate the original

**Tests** (12 new, 46 total):
- `nextInvoiceNumber`: starts at 0001, increments correctly, handles multiple years, ignores malformed numbers, validates date format, pads with zeros
- `issueInvoice`: assigns number and changes status, rejects non-draft, doesn't mutate original, handles existing numbers from same year, preserves all properties
